title: Billing
subtitle: Invoices, payments, cash movements and discounts.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: Every billing-period invoice, across properties.
invoices.emptyDesc: Try a different property, period or status.
invoices.issueSelectedConfirm: Issue {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}? Residents will be notified.

generateDialog.title: Generate invoice
generateDialog.subtitle: Builds the accommodation and discount lines from the resident's current admission.
generateDialog.residentRequired: Pick a resident from the list.

bulkGenerateDialog.title: Bulk generate invoices
bulkGenerateDialog.subtitle: Generates a draft invoice for every active resident of this property who doesn't already have one for the period.
bulkGenerateDialog.skippedOverlapping: {count} skipped: they already have an invoice overlapping this period.

detail.draftOnlyNotice: Only a draft invoice can be edited.
detail.issueConfirmBody: The resident will be notified. A draft can still be edited, but an issued invoice is a financial record and can no longer be changed.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. Generate a new one to regenerate it.
detail.firstInvoicePendingHint: Issue the resident's first invoice before adjusting held advance on another invoice.

adjustAdvance.title: Adjust from advance
adjustAdvance.subtitle: For {resident}, {period}
adjustAdvance.notePlaceholder: e.g. Final month rent adjustment requested by resident
adjustAdvance.nonCashNotice: This uses advance money already collected at admission — it does not record new cash collected.
adjustAdvance.errInvalidAmount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
adjustAdvance.errExceedsHeld: Amount can't exceed the remaining held advance.
adjustAdvance.errExceedsBalance: Amount can't exceed the invoice balance.
adjustAdvance.errFirstInvoiceNotIssued: Issue the resident's first invoice before adjusting held advance on another invoice.
adjustAdvance.errReused: This adjustment was already submitted with different details. Open a new dialog to try again.
adjustAdvance.replayed: This adjustment was already recorded — showing the original.

addLineDialog.title: Add a line item
addLineDialog.waiveConfirm: Waive this food-holiday credit? The resident won't get it on this bill. You can restore it from the food holiday's page.

recordPayment.title: Record payment
recordPayment.subtitle: For {resident}, {period}
recordPayment.errOverpayment: This payment would overpay the invoice — someone may have just recorded one. Refresh and try again.
recordPayment.errReused: This payment was already submitted with different details. Open a new dialog to try again.
recordPayment.replayed: This payment was already recorded — showing the original.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Every payment recorded, across properties.
payments.deleteConfirmBody: This reverses it as if it never happened. The invoice balance will increase.
payments.deleteAdjustmentConfirmBody: This reverses the adjustment, restores the held advance balance on the admission, and increases the invoice balance.
payments.emptyDesc: Try a different property, month or mode.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.nonCashNote: Paid from advance held at admission (not new cash collected).

cashMovements.title: Cash movements
cashMovements.subtitle: Payments, admission advances, deposits, and refunds for the selected range — sums to Cash collected on Reports.
cashMovements.refundsLimitationNotice: Note: Cash receipts include rent payments, admission advances, and security deposits on collection date, and exclude non-cash advance adjustments. Actual refund payouts are not yet recorded as cash outflows (Refunds paid stays ₹0.00), so Net total may overstate cash retained after a resident's refund is paid.
cashMovements.emptyDesc: Try a different month or property.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.subtitle: Per-resident discounts, across properties.
discounts.endConfirmBody: It stops applying to invoices generated after today. Past invoices are unaffected.
discounts.emptyDesc: Try a different property, reason or type.

discountForm.errOverlap: This resident already has a discount active in this period.

reason.no_prior_invoice: First automatic invoice for this resident

autoBilling.needsConfirmationBody: Automatic billing won't issue it. Check the lines and the due date, then issue it yourself.
autoBilling.scheduledBody: Check the lines before then. Hold it if you need more time.
autoBilling.heldBody: It won't be issued until you resume it or issue it yourself.
autoBilling.resumeHint: Resumed drafts are issued at the next day's morning run, at the earliest.
autoBilling.dueFromIssue: The due date is recalculated when it is issued: issue date + grace days.
